ABC Insurance - Health Insurance Policy
Overview
This sample policy document is for demonstration purposes in an insurance chatbot RAG POC.
Coverage
Hospitalization expenses, ICU charges, day-care procedures, ambulance services, pre- and
post-hospitalization expenses, diagnostic tests, and cashless treatment at network hospitals.
Exclusions
Cosmetic surgery, self-inflicted injuries, non-prescribed treatments, experimental procedures unless
specified.
Waiting Period

Waiting Period
30-day initial waiting period except accidents. Pre-existing diseases covered after the specified
waiting period.
Claim Process
Inform ABC Insurance within 24 hours of hospitalization when possible. Submit claim form,
discharge summary, bills, prescriptions, and ID proof.

ABC Insurance - Home Insurance Policy
Coverage
Building structure, household contents, fire, burglary, flood, cyclone, and selected natural disasters.
Optional Covers
Jewellery cover, electronic appliance cover, tenant liability.
Exclusions
Normal wear and tear, intentional damage, war and nuclear risks.
Claim Process
Report the incident, provide photographs, repair estimates, ownership proof, and claim form.

ABC Insurance - Motor Insurance Policy
Coverage
Own damage, third-party liability, theft, fire, flood, earthquake, and accidental damage.
Optional Add-ons
Zero depreciation, roadside assistance, engine protection, return to invoice.
Claim Process
Report the accident immediately, upload photos, submit RC book, driving licence, FIR if applicable,
repair estimate, and claim form.
Exclusions
Driving under the influence, racing, intentional damage, driving without a valid licence.

ABC Insurance - Policy Renewal Guide
Renewal
Renew before the expiry date to maintain continuous coverage.
Methods
Renew through the customer portal, mobile app, branch office, or customer support.
Grace Period
Certain products may offer a grace period as per policy terms.

ABC Insurance - Travel Insurance Policy
Coverage
Medical emergencies, trip cancellation, trip delay, baggage loss, passport loss, emergency
evacuation.
Exclusions
Pre-existing illnesses unless covered, intoxication-related incidents, participation in hazardous
sports unless purchased.
Claim Process
Notify the assistance helpline immediately and submit travel tickets, invoices, police reports (if
applicable), and claim form.
